segments.caption: A man in a light-colored shirt stands outdoors in front of a dark car, speaking directly to the camera in a tutorial setting. A subtitle appears, advising viewers that the content is only a guide.

A man in a light-colored shirt stands outdoors beside a dark car, speaking to the camera. He then moves to sit in the driver's seat, and the camera focuses on his hand as he grips the gear stick, indicating he is preparing to drive.

A man in a light blue shirt is inspecting a car, methodically checking various components including the gear stick, steering column, and wheel, while seated inside the vehicle, suggesting a detailed review or test drive.

A person checks a car tire, then kneels beside the vehicle to assess the situation, indicating a flat or issue. The scene transitions to a roadside assistance advertisement, promoting ŠKODA’s emergency service with a visible warning triangle and contact number, implying the need for professional help. The video concludes with a hand retrieving a spare tire and tools from the car’s trunk, preparing for a tire change.

A man in a white shirt and orange safety vest stands by an open car trunk, retrieving a small bottle and a test stick. He then proceeds to use the stick to test the contents of the bottle, likely performing a roadside breathalyzer or similar test, while standing outdoors in a grassy area.

A man in an orange high-visibility vest is shown changing a flat tire on the side of a road. He first prepares an air compressor, then kneels beside the car to attach the nozzle to the tire valve stem, indicating he is inflating the tire to fix the flat.

A man in a high-visibility vest kneels by a car, using a portable air compressor to inflate a tire, with close-up shots showing the nozzle being inserted into the valve stem and the inflation process.
A person in an orange vest kneels by a car, preparing to check the tire pressure using a handheld digital gauge, with a close-up shot showing the valve stem being fitted with the gauge's probe.

A man in a high-visibility vest kneels beside a car, opening a blue portable air compressor kit to extract a hose and nozzle, then carefully attaches the nozzle to the vehicle's tire valve to inflate the tire.

A person is shown changing a flat tire on a car, beginning with the removal of the lug nuts using a wrench, followed by the careful placement of the spare tire onto the wheel hub. The individual then secures the spare tire by tightening the lug nuts with the wrench. After completing the tire change, the person stands up, appearing satisfied with the work done, and gives a thumbs-up gesture to indicate the successful repair.

A man in an orange safety vest kneels beside a black car, then stands and speaks directly to the camera as the car’s trunk opens behind him, suggesting he is giving a roadside safety or instructional message.

A man in an orange safety vest stands by an open car trunk, then is shown inside the car, looking concerned as he checks his tire pressure with a gauge, indicating he’s dealing with a flat or low tire.
A man is driving a car, looking concerned as he checks his tyre pressure with a gauge, referencing a manual that emphasizes the importance of correct inflation for safety and tyre longevity.

A man is driving a car while visibly distressed, his facial expression conveying frustration or alarm. As he drives, on-screen text appears, instructing him to drive at a maximum speed of 50mph, to accelerate, brake, and corner gently, and to see a local ŠKODA or tyre retailer immediately, indicating his vehicle is under a temporary driving restriction due to a mechanical issue.

A man with dark, curly hair sits in the driver’s seat of a car, looking directly at the camera with a strained, pained expression as he speaks. His eyes are squeezed shut in the first frame, then slowly open as he continues talking, his face contorted with emotion. The background shows a blurred view of green foliage, indicating the car is stationary in a natural, outdoor setting. The consistent, close-up shot emphasizes his intense, emotional delivery.

A man is seen inside a car, looking toward the camera with a concerned expression, suggesting he is experiencing a vehicle issue. The scene transitions to display Skoda's official contact information for roadside assistance and customer services, indicating the video is likely an advertisement or informational clip for the brand's support services.
